I'm Akshay Solse, 30/M
(ACL warrior)

featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Dr Rashmi with complains about sciatic nerve pain on the lower left spine. I had difficulty standing for long periods of time with pain running from lower back to the leg.

I had visited from another country and needed help urgently. I also had limited time during my visits

Dr Rashmi was kind enough to accommodate me on a daily basis and provide me with all necessary therapies (IFT, ultrasound and heat) in order to first alleviate my pain. After that she recommended pin point stretches and exercises which could help me not only manage and reduce pain but also help build my strength which will eliminate the problem altogether.

She was very kind and explained each therapy and exercises in detail which helped me understand why we are doing what I am being asked to. I appreciated the transparency shown by her.

After just 15 sessions with her, I have undergone a transformation where I am able to walk and stand longer. Able to sit longer and also move around freely. Despite all these activities, I don’t experience any pain. I am also able to do the exercises on a daily basis without spending a lot of time.

Overall my experience with Dr Rashmi was really transformational and I would recommend any and all who require physiotherapy treatment to visit her.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We, the parents of Reyansh, would like to express our deepest gratitude to Saba ma’am and Disha ma’am for their extraordinary therapy, dedication, and belief in our child. Their efforts have created a transformation that we once thought was impossible — from a bedridden child to one who now walks with confidence.

A therapist at a clinic in Charni Road had once told us that Reyansh would never walk and would require lifelong support. But Saba ma’am and Disha ma’am saw hope where others did not. Their expertise, consistent encouragement, and unwavering faith helped Reyansh achieve milestones beyond our imagination.

There was a time when he couldn’t even roll over, sit up on his own, or hold or grasp objects. Today, not only does he walk independently, but he has also begun doing activities we never dreamed he would – he even started climbing stairs recently.

We are truly blessed to have found therapists who brought light, progress, and hope into our lives.
Thank you, ma’am, for giving our son the ability to move, grow, and live more independently. We will forever remain grateful.

Disha physiotherapy Clinic. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

To make matters worse, the air conditioning in the waiting area is inadequate, and patients are expected to wait for long periods in uncomfortable, hot conditions.
